capabilities: Filter files by frontmatter include/exclude rules
Upload notes and their embedded assets to a configured VPS endpoint
Serve the published site from a bundled Docker image (Node API + Angular site)
extras: Desktop only (requires Node.js file system access). Server Docker image and plugin are versioned in lockstep. The GitHub repository is a read-only mirror; full docs and issue tracking live in a separate monorepo. README includes detailed network and vault-access privacy disclosures.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a self-hosted server you control instead of a hosted publishing service.

requires.name: API key for the server endpoint

summary: Publishing plugin that uploads selected vault folders to your own VPS with frontmatter-based filtering and incremental sync.
